list.name: plant_name
list.label: Plant
list.definition: SELECT plant_name FROM plants ORDER BY plant_name
list.query: SELECT plant_name FROM plants ORDER BY plant_name

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_timestamp(sr.adjusted_time_ms / 1000.0) AS time, lookup.swc AS value, concat(COALESCE(d.tag, d.name, d.address, 'device'), ' ', sr.sensor, ' SWC') AS metric FROM sensor_readings sr JOIN devices d ON d.id = sr.device_id LEFT JOIN plant_sensors ps ON ps.device_id = d.id AND ps.sensor = sr.sensor LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.id = ps.plant_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT swc FROM response_curve_lookup ORDER BY ABS(predicted_sensor_val - sr.measurement) ASC LIMIT 1) AS lookup WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(sr.adjusted_time_ms / 1000.0) AND ('${plant_name}' = '%' OR p.plant_name LIKE '${plant_name}') AND '${view_mode}' IN ('individual', 'both') ORDER BY 1

SELECT to_timestamp(floor(sr.adjusted_time_ms / ${__interval_ms}) * ${__interval_ms} / 1000.0) AS time, AVG(lookup.swc) AS value, 'Average SWC' AS metric FROM sensor_readings sr JOIN devices d ON d.id = sr.device_id LEFT JOIN plant_sensors ps ON ps.device_id = d.id AND ps.sensor = sr.sensor LEFT JOIN plants p ON p.id = ps.plant_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT swc FROM response_curve_lookup ORDER BY ABS(predicted_sensor_val - sr.measurement) ASC LIMIT 1) AS lookup WHERE $__unixEpochFilter(sr.adjusted_time_ms / 1000.0) AND ('${plant_name}' = '%' OR p.plant_name LIKE '${plant_name}') AND '${view_mode}' IN ('average', 'both') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
